As a Consulting Solution Architect for the Data Management domain, you will serve as a trusted advisor throughout consulting engagements — helping clients shape feasible solution options, leading or supporting the design of custom, high‑value solutions, and ensuring strong domain integrity aligned with the broader SimCorp One solution design. You will play a central role in supporting scalable, high‑quality custom implementations and contribute to consistency and excellence across our Consulting organization.

You will collaborate closely with colleagues across Consulting, Product Management, and Value Streams to ensure our custom solutions remain both feasible and aligned to SimCorp standards. You will also help advance our practices, strengthen our knowledge base, and mentor the next generation of solutioning talent within SimCorp.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**As SimCorp embarks on the SimCorp One journey, the Consulting Solution Architect plays a critical role in enabling the Consulting organization to deliver high‑quality, scalable custom solutions. Consulting Solution Architects ensure that custom client requirements are shaped and delivered with strong domain integrity, consistency, and alignment with SimCorp’s delivery methodologies (Compass) and the SimCorp One solution.

You will:

• Influence key architectural decisions in strategic and complex consulting projects

• Strengthen our consulting methodologies and enablement efforts

• Contribute to the evolution of consulting solution best practices and patterns

Our new Consulting Solution Architects bring deep domain experience within the scope of the Data Management Sub-Service Line and the consulting skills needed to act as trusted advisors to internal and external clients.

This is a global position, with potential locations across SimCorp offices worldwide. International travel may be required based on client needs. The role reports to the Global Practice Lead.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Global Practice Ownership

**

• Own the Global consulting practice within your domain. This includes ownership of the global consulting artifacts for your domain.

• Contribute with structured feedback into standards evolution.

• Shape and define our consulting practice within your domain.

• Support the enablement of consultants to deliver custom client solutions with high quality, consistency, and aligned with the SimCorp One solution.

**Scoping & Advisory

**

• Lead or support domain‑specific consulting scoping during sales and early project phases for complex and strategic consulting engagements

• Act as the key advisor for solution options and custom feasibility

• Collaborate with Sales, Engagement Leads, Product Management, and Value Streams

• Define and validate custom architecture and design in complex and strategic client projects

• Ensure custom build quality and provide ongoing design assurance

• Resolve domain-specific challenges in collaboration with consulting, value streams, and product teams

**Knowledge Enablement

**

• Document and disseminate domain knowledge and best practices

• Support onboarding and capability building within Consulting

• Collaborate on cross‑functional learning initiatives

**Collaboration & Influence

**

• Work closely with Product Management, Value Streams, and project teams

• Represent your domain in discussions on solution direction and domain challenges

• Interface with clients, including senior stakeholders, on custom solution matters

**Mentoring & Community Leadership

**

• Coach consultants and aspiring architects

• Help grow solutioning maturity within Consulting

• Influence cross‑domain architecture discussions and knowledge sharing

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to excel at several of the following skills and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest.

• Relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics or a relevant Business degree

• At least 7+ years of proven experience designing and implementing SimCorp Dimension solutions

• Deep business knowledge within the Data Management domain. Experience with the SimCorp Data Management Core solution and the SimCorp Data Management Service is a plus.

• Understanding of our clients’ general business processes and operating model

• International experience and global mindset

• Have been involved in several SimCorp Dimension implementations from the early stages of the project

• Ability to build relationships, drive discussions and impact stakeholders when required

• Engagement in partnering with various parts of the SimCorp organization

• Proactiveness, creativeness and commercial mindedness with a global perspective

• Proficiency in English

**Benefits

**SimCorp offers several benefits that might play a significant factor in considering whether to accept a job offer. Since SimCorp operates in 30+ offices worldwide, the benefits package may vary from country to country.

Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please click below to apply. For further information about the position, please contact Kasper Bøgh Larsen, Global Practice Lead Data and Post Trade or Hanna Brzózka, Lead Talent Acquisition Partner at hanna.brzozka@simcorp.com to learn more about the vacancy, recruitment process or SimCorp internal transfer policy.

**Please note that only applications sent through our Workday system will be processed.

**In addition to submitting your CV please add a short Cover Letter motivating your interest elaborating on:

• What is your vision for yourself as a Solution Architect?

• What do you hope to accomplish?

• How will you work together with the GPL and other Solution Architects to advance both your and SimCorp’s visions?

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

__________

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

**Job Description

**

_Do you want to help shape how a large IT company measures, manages and documents its information security? Are you motivated by turning data, risk and regulation into practical decisions? If so, you may be our next colleague in the newly established GRC team in Netcompany's Group CISO Office.

_

**Responsibilities and technologies

**

As a member of the GRC team, you will help ensure that Netcompany has an accurate, data-driven view of the effectiveness of its security controls and its level of compliance. The team takes a pragmatic and technically grounded approach to governance, risk and compliance, and works closely with the Application Security team, the Operations organisation, Internal IT and other business functions across the group.

The GRC team is a small team of colleagues with complementary profiles. We do not expect any one candidate to cover every area described below. Instead, we are looking for broad profiles with solid experience across several of these areas and the motivation to develop within the rest.

**Your responsibilites will typically include:

**

• Developing and maintaining risk scenarios, assessing the effectiveness of mitigating controls against the scenarios, and conducting risk assessments to support business decisions

• Establishing automated measurements and KPIs that provide insight into the implementation and effectiveness of security controls across the business

• Interpreting regulatory and contractual security requirements and translating these into Netcompany's security baselines and standard methodologies

• Planning and executing security awareness activities, including phishing simulations, targeted micro-learning, and onboarding/yearly awareness training

• Driving smaller security improvement projects from planning to implementation, combining coordination with hands-on execution

• Developing, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuityDeveloping, maintaining and testing internal security processes, such as major incident response, crisis management and business continuity

**About you

**

You have broad experience within information security and a solid understanding of its technical aspects alongside a general understanding of the software development life cycle. You combine this with the ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions. Furthermore, you are pragmatic, take ownership of your work and prefer a hands-on approach.

**To succeed in this role you:

**

• Hold a relevant degree or equivalent experience; within IT, engineering, computer science or a similar field.

• Strong analytic skills, with the ability to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions independently.

• Experience within several of the areas listed in the overview of responsibilities in the role.

• Solid communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical teams, business functions, management and, on occasion, customers.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken).

**Continue developing with us

**

At Netcompany, we focus on your personal and professional development.

We provide a structured career model that allows you to build on your existing experiences.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will support your development and help you achieve your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in management gives you concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and desires.

Additionally, you will be enrolled in our internal training programme, Netcompany Academy, where you are offered courses and seminars tailored to you and where you are in your career. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your professional skills. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company helps you build a solid network and provides a strong foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand your network.

**Send us an application

**

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

_All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

_

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance.

BASE life science is a fast-growing consultancy that helps life science companies worldwide deliver better outcomes for their business and their patients. We are looking for a Legal Counsel who wants to join an ambitious and dynamic team and become the in-house legal partner to our business.

About the role

The Legal Counsel is the in-house legal partner to the business at BASE life science. The role owns our contracts, policies and privacy compliance, and uses AI to make legal support faster and easier to use, without compromising on quality.

A substantial part of the role, especially in the first period, is to bring our contract management and our policies fully up to date and compliant - and to keep them that way.

Your responsibilities include:

Contracts

• Own the Master Service Agreement framework, so our agreements are balanced, clear and workable for BASE, our clients and our partners.

• Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements with sales and delivery leads.

• Take full ownership of contract management: bring every agreement up to date and make the valid version easy to find.

Policies and privacy

• Own our policies, including the data privacy policies and the documentation on personal data, and keep them compliant across the countries where BASE operates.

• Own privacy compliance: manage the external privacy provider and maintain our privacy compliance platform, the Article 30 record and our data processing agreements.

• Run a fixed review cycle with clear owners, so contracts and policies stay current all year.

• Keep BASE audit-ready, support audits and close the findings.

Advice to the business

• Advise on commercial and employment law questions, including country-specific advice in Request for Proposal processes.

• Spot legal risks early, follow changes in laws and regulations, and turn them into clear guidance.

• Support BASE leadership with legal input that fits our strategy and commercial focus.

• Work closely with Infosys Legal, with sparring both ways, and coordinate external law firms and the legal budget.

• Train colleagues in privacy and contract basics, so the business can handle more on its own.

AI in legal work

• Build AI into our legal methods, templates and playbooks, with quality checks so speed never costs accuracy.

• Make relevant legal knowledge available across BASE through our shared AI agents, with the right access and confidentiality controls.

• Contribute the legal perspective to AI governance, including the EU Artificial Intelligence Act.

You bring:

• jur. with 2-3 years of experience from a law firm or an in-house legal team.

• Solid grounding in commercial contracts and in the General Data Protection Regulation in practice.

• Hands-on experience with AI tools in legal work, and a clear view of where human review is required.

• Fluent in Danish and English. Pragmatic, structured and easy to approach.

• An advantage: experience with contract management and privacy compliance systems such as Pactius and ComplyCloud, Request for Proposal processes across countries, and Danish employment law.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

• The Master Service Agreement framework is updated and used consistently.

• Contracts and policies are complete, current and easy to find.

• BASE is audit-ready on privacy, and the privacy provider works to clear priorities.

• AI-supported templates and playbooks are in use, and the business experiences legal support as quicker and easier.

You will be based in Denmark, report to our Chief Operating Officer and work closely with our colleagues in Infosys Legal.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE life science?

You are trusted from day one. Colleagues help each other across teams and countries, speak openly and follow through. We are sharp and professional in what we deliver, and we want the best for each other and for our clients - because the good everyday is something we build together.

You will have real ownership, the backing of our Chief Operating Officer and Infosys Legal, and room to grow. We offer flexibility in how and where you work, a strong focus on well-being and development, and the tools you need to do your best work.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you want a role where your legal skills truly matter in a growing international company, we would be happy to hear from you.

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE life science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
RWE is looking for an experienced O&M Site Manager to lead the site-based operations organisation at Thor Offshore Wind Farm. In this key leadership role, you will be responsible for the safe, compliant, reliable and efficient operation and maintenance of the 1 GW wind farm, including its onshore and offshore substations connected to the Energinet transmission system. You will lead a multidisciplinary operations organisation and play a central role in preparing Thor for the transition from the initial OEM service and warranty period to long-term owner-led operations. The role reports to the General Manager for Thor.

**About the role

**

• Lead the day-to-day operations organisation, including three Team Leads, two technician teams and a transmission team responsible for the transmission assets, as well as coordinating external service providers.

• Take overall responsibility for safe, compliant, economical and uninterrupted operations, ensuring adherence to internal requirements, applicable regulations and RWE’s HSE standards and Zero Incident Policy.

• Work closely with the site-based Asset Integrity team and take responsibility for the O&M facilities and logistics setup required to support safe and effective offshore operations.

• Prepare the organisation during the first two years to take over wind turbine service and maintenance activities following the OEM service and warranty period.

• Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement in line with the overall strategy of the RWE Offshore Fleet, setting short-, medium- and long-term operational targets and ensuring their achievement.

• Own the general site and logistics budget, oversee operational performance reporting and contribute to the financial performance reporting of the wind farm.

• Maximise production by ensuring effective maintenance, troubleshooting and monitoring activities, while ensuring that all work is appropriately documented in SAP PM/MM.

• Lead and develop the operations team in line with RWE leadership values, fostering an open, constructive and consistent working environment with a strong focus on safety and operational performance.

**Job requirements and experience

**

• A completed engineering degree or qualification as a state-certified technical engineer.

• At least eight years of relevant experience within offshore wind, power generation or a transmission company.

• Strong knowledge of offshore wind farm organisation and operations, ideally combined with experience in owner operations and HV transmission assets.

• Proven experience in leading and managing teams across multiple organisational levels, combined with strong organisational and planning skills.

• Strong technical and commercial understanding of power plant operations, together with knowledge of offshore-specific areas such as logistics.

• A strong commitment to occupational safety and environmental standards, with experience implementing relevant HSE requirements in an operational environment.

• Extensive knowledge of relevant national and international technical norms and standards, combined with a solution-oriented and decisive approach.

• As this is a site-based role, you are expected to work on site for a minimum of four days per week, with flexibility to travel to site at other times when required.

Given the site-based nature of the role, we expect the successful candidate to be present at the Thor site approximately four days per week, with flexibility to attend on other days when required.

Thor offshore wind farm (TOWF) will be built 22 kilometres off the coast of Thorsminde with a capacity of more than 1 GW. 72 units of Siemens Gamesa’s flagship SG 14-236 DD offshore wind turbines are planned to be installed. Once fully operational in 2027, Thor will produce green electricity to more than 1 million Danish households.

Once fully operational in 2027, Thor is expected to generate green electricity equivalent to the annual consumption of more than one million Danish households.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

• Testing: Playwright

• AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

• Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

If you want to run the outbound engine that fills our pipeline, lead a team of BDRs who live on the phone, and own the number that turns into revenue, come join us!

Our AI SDRs handle inbound end to end, from speed-to-lead to qualification. That leaves our BDRs free to do one thing: outbound. Finding the hospitality and retail brands that aren't looking for us yet, and starting the conversation.

Outbound already works for us in the UK and Germany. Now it needs to run as a machine.

We need the person who owns it. Who decides which accounts we go after, in what order, through which channel and with which message. Then measures it, and makes it better every week.

If you want to be the person who leads business development at All Gravy, keep reading!

**🥞 **The mission

****All Gravy is the frontline operating system. One platform for comms, learning, engagement, operations and scheduling, with built-in AI. Think WhatsApp meets Duolingo meets Claude for frontline workers. Used daily by 350+ brands like GAIL's, L'Osteria, Dishoom, 7-Eleven and Honest Burgers.

We're growing 3x year-over-year across the UK, the Nordics and Germany, where revenue has grown 12x since the start of the year.

**🎯 **The role****You lead our outbound BDR team and own outbound-sourced pipeline: meetings that turn into opportunities, opportunities that turn into revenue, and that our AEs are glad to take.

You lead from the front. You coach, you build the system, and you still pick up the phone.

**⚙️ **What you get from day one

****We invested in RevOps and sales tooling far earlier than most companies our size do. You get to run business development on top of it:

• Lead lists that build themselves. Accounts are sourced, enriched and assigned to reps automatically, so nobody spends their morning in a spreadsheet.

• A daily dial deck. Every BDR starts the day with researched accounts and call cards ready, and call outcomes flow back into HubSpot on their own.

• Hyperbound for practice. BDRs rehearse cold calls, openers and objection handling against AI buyer personas modelled on our ICP, scored against our own scorecards, before they dial a real lead.

• Every call captured. Attention records and scores real calls, so you coach from what was said.

• Inbound off your plate. AI SDRs handle every inbound lead, so your team spends all its time on outbound.

• Reporting you can trust. HubSpot on a Snowflake data layer, with live funnel, pipeline and rep scorecards.

• A playbook the system runs. Qualification, handoffs and deal stages live in our own GTM Suite. When we change the process, we ship an update.

**🔥 **What you'll do

• Own pipeline generation. Set outbound pipeline targets with sales leadership, hit them, and know exactly which segments, markets and plays deliver.

• Lead and coach the BDR team. Hire, run call reviews, listen in live, and build Hyperbound roleplays for the objections your team keeps losing on. Develop BDRs into AEs. That's how many of ours got there.

• Use AI where it helps. Agents do the research and personalisation. Your BDRs do the conversations. You decide where that line sits.

• Sharpen targeted outbound. The lists are there. You decide which segments and markets to push, design the plays across phone, email and LinkedIn, and kill what doesn't work fast.

• Own outbound conversion. Connect rate, meeting rate, show rate, meeting-to-opportunity. You know where the funnel leaks and you fix it.

• Work hand in hand with marketing. Tell them which messages and segments land on the phone, and turn events and campaigns into outbound plays.

• Still dial. You show the team how it's done, and you enjoy it.

🧠 Who you are

• You've led BDRs. 4+ years in B2B SaaS business development, with at least 1-2 years as a team lead.

• You beat your pipeline targets. And you can show us the numbers.

• Cold calling is still your thing. You'd never ask your team to do something you won't.

• You think in systems. You design the process, the sequences and the reporting. You've built in HubSpot or similar and know your way around Clay, Apollo and the rest.

• You're AI-first. You use Claude or similar every day for research, personalisation and analysis. You see agents as part of your team, not a threat to it.

• You make people better. Your BDRs improve every week because you coach them every week, and you make practice a daily habit instead of a quarterly workshop.

• Excellent English. German is a big plus, as we're scaling DACH fast. Danish, Swedish or Norwegian is a plus too.

🚩 Probably not for you if

• You want to manage people but stopped dialling a while ago.

• You measure success in calls and emails sent.

• You'd rather build your own tooling from scratch than get the most out of a stack that's already running.

• You see AI as a threat to the BDR role. We think it changes the role, and we want someone excited to define what comes next.

**📈 **Where this goes

****3 months: You know the funnel end to end, your targets are set, every BDR practises in Hyperbound daily, and your first outbound plays by segment and market are live.

6 months: The team hits its pipeline target month after month. Meeting-to-opportunity conversion is up, and you know exactly which plays to scale in each market.

Beyond: As we expand into new markets, you build out the function, toward Head of Business Development.

**💎 **Why All Gravy

• Grow fast, for real. We promote from within, move quickly, and give you real responsibility from day one.

• A culture that actually develops you. Honest feedback, active coaching, and the autonomy to experiment.

• Work that matters. Your work directly affects the daily lives of millions of frontline workers.

• People who've done it before. Ex-founders and operators who've built, scaled and won, and want to do it again, bigger.

• The good stuff too. Prime office location, team lunches, Friday bars, padel tournaments, wine tastings, offsites, top-tier equipment, and a fridge that's always stocked. Competitive salary and warrant package.

****📍 Practical

• Hybrid.

• Full-time.

• You report to Malek, our Sales Director, and work closely with our AEs, marketing and RevOps.

🙌 Ready to build? Apply, even if you don't tick every box. Let's build the future of frontline work together.

It’s an exciting time to join Tactile. We're a diverse team of storytellers, puzzle enthusiasts, and casual mobile game creators. Our story began in 2008 in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, and since then, we have experienced continuous growth, establishing ourselves as one of the largest gaming companies in Denmark. In more recent years, we have been scaling fast, in large part thanks to the success of a little game called Lily’s Garden. Now we’re on a mission to solidify our position as one of the leaders in creating out-of-the-ordinary casual puzzle games.

With more than 350 talented individuals, we are a mix of over 50 nationalities and 43% women. We truly appreciate the richness of different experiences and perspectives that Tactilers bring to the game. This is why we foster a lean organisational culture, in which each individual is encouraged to take responsibility, be open, and grow in their own way. We pride ourselves on cultivating a studio environment that avoids crunch, fosters your skills regardless of your discipline, and provides a space for you to be creative alongside other passionate and invested storytellers.

**🚀 Your Role & Impact

**We're currently growing our Core team and are on the lookout for another Product Designer to join our team of talented engineers.

The Core team builds the internal tools behind Tactile own LiveOps, Marketing and Data operations, the backbone of our studio. We're looking for a second Product Designer to join Joy and our engineers in designing business-critical tools that every team at Tactile depends on.

**This role is based in our Copenhagen office.

****How We Design

**

• Our tools are data-heavy: dashboards, large tables, complex filters, multi-step workflows. Static mockups can't show how they behave with real data, so we prototype first, in code. We use Claude Code and agentic workflows to build working prototypes, and those prototypes are what we hand off to developers. Figma is still where we sketch and brainstorm

• AI amplifies our design. It doesn't do design for us. It lets us take on complex workflows that used to get skipped because they took too much effort

• Quality is not up for debate. We know what good looks like, and we don't ship slop

• Our product design philosophies are inspired by Vercel, Linear and GitHub

This is roughly how we work today. It isn't strict, and we're open to what you bring. Here's a talk that captures our thinking.

Okay, let’s get a little bit more specific. Here’s what you’ll be doing on the day-to-day:

• Research, design and prototype interfaces for our internal tools, then hand working prototypes off to developers

• Work with your team who use our tools to simplify their workflows

• Use AI to explore, iterate and prototype efficiently, while you stay responsible for every design decision and not outsource creative thinking.

• Evolve and contribute to our design system and processes

• We don't have a big UX team, and that's on purpose. You'll work every day with Product Managers, Frontend and Backend engineers, Artists, Game Programmers. We believe good products come from working across disciplines, so we care about the end product, not design operations

**What We’re Looking For

**

• Hands-on experience with technical B2B products: dashboards, tables, filters, dense interfaces

• You care more about the end product than about design process, and you thrive working across disciplines

• Comfortable contributing directly to projects via PRs to improve designs or UX without waiting for programmers to implement them

• Experience in designing with Claude Code or similar agentic tools

• Real openness to agentic workflows, without an "AI produces slop" mindset

• Comfort prototyping in code, or a strong drive to learn

• A sharp eye for high design craft, quality, and candour when something isn't good enough

**You'll Make Us Extra Excited If You Also Have

**

• Experience in using Figma/Figma Make or similar design tools

• Programmer background, comfortable diving into fronted code if necessary

• Know-how of shadcn, Untitled UI or similar SaaS UI libraries

**What’s in it for you?

**🌆 Beautiful office space with probably the best view in Copenhagen

🩺 Pension and private health insurance

💻 A chance to work with the latest tools and technology

📚 Opportunities for individual growth with development talks as well as workshops, books and courses

🌮 Daily, healthy organic breakfast and lunch prepared by our professional chefs in-house

🥳 Social activities, including game nights, book club, Friday bar and more

🔍 Free Danish lessons with our in-house Danish teacher

**Our interview process

**Submit your application via the fill-in form at the top of this page. This is the easiest and fastest way to get in touch with our recruiters. We foster an inclusive culture and accessible workplace and want to make sure we provide everyone with the same opportunities for success. This is why we encourage you to apply regardless of your gender, sexuality, age, nationality, neurodiversity or disability. We review applications based on competencies and experience, so please do tell us about your favorite projects and technologies.

After we review your application, you can expect to go through the following conversations:

☕ Introductory coffee chat, primarily to ensure that we’re aligned on the scope of the role and that all of your questions are answered.

🧪 In person technical interview (mix of design whiteboarding and designing with AI) with Joy, your future product design colleague, and Gab, Core Team Lead.

💜 The final conversation will be with your future team, to discuss if you’re aligned on values and ways of working.

We are thorough in our hiring process, as it's essential to us that we select new Tactilers carefully - just as it is vital to ensure that we are the right place for you.

We want to ensure you have a great candidate experience whilst in our recruitment process. We will do everything within reason to ensure that your interview takes place in an environment that fairly and accurately assesses your skills. If you need assistance or accommodation, please let us know.

We look forward to receiving your application! 👋

Are you an experienced UX Designer who enjoys making complex technical systems easier to use? Do you want a hands-on role turning system logic and user needs into interfaces people rely on to configure, monitor and operate energy systems?

At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than 700 employees worldwide, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that Improve Tomorrow.

At DEIF, we develop advanced control solutions for decentralised power production and complex energy management systems. You will help make these systems understandable and usable in real-world working situations.

We are looking for a UX Designer who can take design work from understanding the problem through to implementation. You will create clear, consistent interfaces, develop our design system and contribute to continuous improvements across our products.

**Your role

**You will join Product Insights & Design and collaborate closely with developers and domain experts. Your main focus will be hands-on design and delivery, supported by research and usability evaluation.

**You Will Work Across

**

• Embedded interfaces on controller devices

• Cloud‑based platforms controlling gensets, hybrid systems, and microgrids

“This is a hands-on UX role designing interfaces for complex energy systems. Within R&D, we are moving towards a more insights-driven approach to product development. Product Insights & Design is building a more systematic way to gather and connect product and user insights and translate them into design decisions and interfaces that make DEIF’s products easier to use. If you want to make an impact on our products and help shape how we work with design, this role could be a good match,” explains Kirsten Knox, Head of Product Insights & Design and Design Specialist.

**Your Tasks And Responsibilities

**

• Translate complex workflows and system behaviour into clear user journeys, information architecture and interaction designs

• Create wireframes and prototypes to explore, communicate and evaluate design solutions

• Collaborate with developers and domain experts to understand technical constraints, user needs and the consequences of design decisions

• Define feasible design solutions and document interactions, states and behaviours clearly for implementation

• Support developers during implementation, review the resulting interfaces and help resolve usability issues

• Contribute to user research and usability testing, combining qualitative and quantitative evidence where appropriate and consolidating findings to inform design decisions

• Develop and maintain shared components and interaction patterns in our design system to improve consistency across products

**Your Experience And Approach

**

• Experience taking UX work from problem exploration through to implemented interfaces, with a portfolio that explains your decisions and contribution

• Ability to understand complex workflows and system behaviour and turn them into clear interaction designs

• Practical experience with wireframing, prototyping, usability evaluation and design systems

• Ability to explain design decisions and work constructively with technical colleagues

• A structured approach to several concurrent tasks, making pragmatic trade-offs and adapting when priorities change

• Experience with industrial products, embedded interfaces or other complex technical systems would be an advantage

**Why join DEIF?

**At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a family-owned company with strong values and a culture built on trust, openness, and collaboration. You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.

In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, we offer you:

• Flexible work arrangements, including home office days. Your workplace will be in Skive.

• The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in state-of-the-art facilities

• On-the-job training and knowledge sharing with skilled employees

• In-house canteen and physiotherapist at our headquarters

• Fitness breaks, social events, and much more supporting your wellbeing.

Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our career page today!

**Interested?

**Send your application and CV no later than December 2nd, via our website https://career.deif.com/recruitment/job-openings/ . We expect interviews to be conducted on an ongoing basis.

If you want to learn more about the position, feel free to contact Kirsten Knox on e-mail kdk@deif.com or +45 9614 5763.

Do you love turning menus and interfaces into something players actually enjoy clicking through, and want to own that from first sketch to final implementation? We’d love to talk to you.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're working on our most ambitious project to date: a new systemic open-world game built around a beloved IP, with our own spin on it. A bold new direction for us! And we're just getting started.

Now, we’re looking for a UI/UX Designer to join a team of around 15-20 people and own the UI/UX for the entire game. You’ll be the first dedicated UI/UX designer on the team (and at Triband generally!), so you’ll shape the game’s interface aesthetic and logic as well as player experience from the ground up.

**Here’s What You’ll Do Day To Day

**

• Own the full UI/UX pipeline for the game: from flow, wireframes, and mockups through to final in-engine implementation (we use Unity)

• Design and build UI elements like menus, icons, HUDs, and input controls that are clear, playful, and true to the game’s tone

• Bake in accessibility design and settings from the start, not as an afterthought

• Create dynamic transitions and animations that make the UI feel alive

• Implement your own designs solidly in Unity (you won’t be just handing off mockups!)

• Collaborate closely with game designers and programmers to keep the UI consistent, technically sound, and fun to use

• Maintain a consistent visual language and set of UI standards as the game grows

**You’re probably a good match if

**

• You have solid experience owning UI/UX work end to end, from flow through to final implementation

• You have strong Unity implementation skills and are comfortable taking your own UI work all the way into engine

• You’re skilled in Illustrator

• You have experience mocking up interactive flows in a tool like Figma, Miro, or similar (any tool is fine)

• You genuinely enjoy working within an existing visual style rather than starting from a blank page every time

• You’ve shipped a mobile game before, including responsive/adaptive interfaces

• You have a strong eye for color, shapes, contrast, and readability

**Nice to have

**

• A passion for accessibility and usability, especially for family-friendly/casual audiences

• You see real value in user testing and what it can teach you

• An interest in motion design and UI animation

**What Always Matters To Us At Triband

**This project is something new, but our ways of working are the same. We’ve always believed that games are made by teams, not solo rockstars, and good ideas can come from anyone. What we also believe in:

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward.

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture.

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them.

• You’re up for experimentation, and at the same time you don’t get too precious when the experience tells you you’re wrong.

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place.

**Practicalities

**

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• This role is based in the Greater Copenhagen area, and we’re not considering people located outside of commuting distance for this one.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10–15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

**We offer

**

• A shot at shaping the interface of a live game played by millions

• A tight, collaborative team where your ideas actually make it into the game

• A playful work environment where trying the silly idea is encouraged

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, and whatever else Tribanders turn into a tradition

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant, with plant-based options and soft ice on Thursdays

• Private health insurance paid by us

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked

• Endless amounts of Noda

**WHAT THE TRIBAND?

**Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide.

From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make people laugh. We explore comedy through gameplay, which means we like to break player expectations, create surprising interactions, use great music and slick art, and build quirky worlds full of personality.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games. And we believe diversity makes teams better. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and who are excited to challenge us and our way of doing things.

jobs.description:
**Location: Copenhagen (please note this job requires onsite presence - remote work not possible)

**Do you want to work hands-on with modern cloud-based technologies, data engineering and AI, while helping turn complex data into solutions that create real business value?

Join us as a Data Engineer to become part of an environment where knowledge is shared, and curiosity is encouraged. And work with tools such as Snowflake, dbt, Claude, Microsoft Azure, SQL and AI as you help develop the data platform that enables actionable insights, intelligent solutions and data-driven applications.

“You’ll get to contribute to solutions for a wide portfolio of customers - without compromising on flexibility and work-life balance. This also allows you to develop your expertise through challenging assignments and collaboration with experienced colleagues,” says Brian Landbo, Manager, SmartX.

**At NTT DATA Business Solutions, we believe that development happens when people learn and solve challenges together. You will become part of our ambitious and agile SmartX team where the pace is high and where we work with modern cloud technologies, data engineering, analytics and AI through our data platform.

**

You thrive in a collaborative environment where professional dialogue and knowledge sharing are an important part of everyday work. **Finally, We Imagine That You

**

• Have hands-on experience with and a solid understanding of Snowflake as a cloud data warehouse

• Have strong SQL and data modelling skills, including experience with dimensional modelling such as facts, dimensions and star schemas

Apply today and make NTT DATA Business Solutions the place where you grow.

As a global leader in facilities services we connect people and places to make the world work better. Whether directly or indirectly, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our placemakers in delivering exceptional workplace experiences for our customers. Together, we make space for people and businesses to thrive.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Language: English

Department: Finance IT | Business Central Cloud Product Specialist team

Reports to: Head of Finance IT

Main purpose of the position

We are on a global ERP transformation journey, moving our Finance landscape from Navision and SAP to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Cloud. As a member of our Business Central Cloud Product Specialist team, you will be a product authority for Business Central Finance. You will shape how the global solution is designed, make sure it stays standard and cloud-ready, and act as a trusted advisor to Finance stakeholders across the countries.

What you’ll do:

• Provide functional leadership and Finance expertise across NAV-to-Business Central upgrades and rollouts.

• Own the product design of Business Central Finance and ensure that solution designs follow ISS guidelines and design principles.

• Shape scalable, controlled Business Central Finance solutions based on standard functionality and a clean core on cloud, challenging customisations and proposing standard alternatives.

• Configure and validate core Finance functions, including GL, AR, AP, Fixed Assets, Intercompany, VAT/tax, reporting and budgeting.

• Translate business requirements into standard processes, designs, controls and acceptance criteria.

• Drive fit-to-standard delivery across migration, integrations, testing, cutover and stabilisation.

• Assess ISV apps from Microsoft AppSource and recommend the best fit against standard functionality.

• Identify and drive opportunities for AI and automation in Finance processes.

• Review and approve designs from internal teams and external partners before build.

• Validate and implement small changes in the business-as-usual (BAU) landscape.

• Engage with business process owners, finance users, country CFOs and other senior stakeholders to align on requirements and solutions.

Key qualifications:

• At least 8 years of experience with Navision/Business Central Finance.

• Extensive hands-on experience in Business Central Finance configuration, implementation and end-to-end finance processes (e.g. record to report, procure to pay, order to cash).

• Solid understanding of Business Central Cloud, standard functionality and clean core principles.

• Experience with the Business Central ISV ecosystem and AppSource, with a clear view of which apps work best and when standard is the better choice.

• Experience applying AI and automation in Finance, e.g. Copilot in Business Central and Power Automate.

• Experience from global implementations in large, international organisations.

• Used to working in a global team and in an organisation with a decentralised decision structure.

• Self-driven, structured and able to take ownership with limited guidance.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage confidently with country CFOs and senior leaders.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken.

What we offer

A key role in one of the largest Finance IT transformations at ISS, with real influence on the future global Finance platform. You will join the Business Central Cloud Product Specialist team, a committed international team, and work closely with Finance and IT stakeholders across the organisation.

Why ISS

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.

ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.

Become more. Become ISS.

How you’ll apply

Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for. We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

**What You Will Do. A Glimpse Into Your Role

**As Managing Director Denmark at Global Blue by Shift4, you will oversee one of the company’s leanest but most dynamic organizations, operating in a highly competitive environment centred around Copenhagen and Kastrup Airport refund operations. You will combine strategic leadership with a hands-on operational approach, ensuring excellence in day-to-day activities while driving long-term growth.

You will work closely with your manager to shape and implement the country strategy, while actively engaging with merchants, airport stakeholders, Customs (SKAT) and your internal teams across both Tax Free and Payment, an area expected to become increasingly important in Denmark over the coming months and years. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a versatile position, balancing commercial development, operational oversight and strategic execution within a Nordic market that demands agility, strong relationships and a strong focus on market-share defence.

**Main Responsibilities

**Your responsibilities will span both strategic and operational dimensions, including:

**Strategic & Business Leadership

**

• Develop, implement and execute business strategies to achieve short- and long-term goals.

• Drive market growth by hunting new merchant partnerships in Payment and farming existing relationships in Tax Free Shopping, defending the established market position.

• Prepare business plans to improve cost-efficiency and operational performance.

• Lead strategy reviews and business development initiatives, identifying opportunities in current and new segments.

**Operational & Team Management

**

• Ensure excellence in airport refund operations, coordinating closely with the Refund Manager and refund agents.

• Support and supervise Key Account Managers in merchant management and sales activities, while maintaining hands-on management of your own merchant portfolio.

• Address day-to-day operational issues with merchants, including IT-related matters.

• Manage hiring, terminations, salary reviews and bonus decisions in alignment with line management.

**Stakeholder Management

**

• Maintain strong relationships with business partners, authorities and key stakeholders, including Customs, airports, merchants, tourism associations and government bodies.

• Negotiate with airport authorities on operational contracts and collaborations.

**Governance & Compliance

**

• Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, rules and company policies.

• Provide monthly reports, market insights and strategic advice to upper management.

• Oversee internal and external communications and key business documentation.

**Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if:

**

jobs.description:
**Would you like to shape the Human Resources agenda for a global Operations, Manufacturing and Quality organization within GN Hearing? Are you motivated by partnering closely with senior leaders, leading international teams and translating business priorities into HR strategies that strengthen performance, capability and transformation?

**Then this could be an exciting opportunity to join GN Hearing as Head of HR, Operations, Manufacturing and Quality.

In this role, you will provide strategic HR leadership and act as a trusted executive business partner to global leaders across Operations, Manufacturing and Quality. You will lead an international HR team and play a central role in building the organizational capabilities needed to support a high-performing, global and transforming business.

**The team you will be part of

**You will join the global HR organization for the Hearing Division and become a member of the HR Leadership Team for GN Hearing.

You will work closely with senior leaders across Hearing Operations, Manufacturing and Quality, as well as HR colleagues in the regions and HR Centres of Excellence.

You will lead three direct reports and an overall international HR team of approximately 15 colleagues across Denmark, China and Malaysia. Together, the team combines global alignment with local understanding to deliver trusted, data-informed and pragmatic HR support in a complex and multicultural organization.

**Your contribution is appreciated, and you will

**

• Set the HR strategy, priorities and people agenda for Global Operations, Manufacturing and Quality, aligned with business priorities and the overall HR strategy for GN Hearing.

• Act as a trusted advisor and constructive sparring partner to senior leaders on organizational performance, workforce planning, talent, succession, leadership and capability development.

• Lead, develop and support an international HR organization of approximately 15 colleagues, including three direct reports based in Denmark, China and Malaysia.

• Drive clear priorities, strong collaboration and high-quality HR delivery across the Global Operations, Manufacturing and Quality.

• Hold overall responsibility for GN Hearing’s global Health & Safety agenda and function, ensuring a strong and consistent approach across locations.

• Translate business priorities into clear and impactful HR plans, including organizational design, transformation, change management and capability building.

• Ensure effective and consistent deployment of global HR processes and policies, including performance management, reward, talent and succession.

• Lead people aspects of organizational changes and restructuring activities, balancing business needs with stakeholder alignment, local compliance and a people-centred approach.

• Use people and business insights to identify opportunities, anticipate risks and enable sound, forward-looking decisions.

• Contribute actively to the development and priorities of the HR Leadership Team for the Hearing Division.

**To perform well in the role, we imagine that you

**

• Bring extensive experience from a senior HR business partnering or HR leadership role, acting as a trusted executive business partner in a complex, international and matrix-based organization - ideally with 15+ years of relevant professional experience.

• Have a strong understanding of Manufacturing, Operations and Quality environments, including the people priorities associated with global, operational and potentially regulated settings.

• Have successfully led and developed HR teams across countries and cultures, creating clarity, trust, accountability and shared direction.

• Have experience working with or supporting organizations in APAC; this is a significant advantage given the role’s global scope and team presence in China and Malaysia.

• Combine strategic perspective with a pragmatic, hands-on approach and the ability to turn priorities into sustainable HR initiatives and measurable outcomes.

• Are an engaging and credible leader who builds strong relationships across the organization and takes a genuine interest in understanding the business and how value is created.

• Bring a transformation mindset, sound judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively when needed.

• Use data and insights to guide decisions.

• Communicate clearly and effectively in English.

The role is based in Ballerup, Denmark, and involves approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

At GN, we encourage flexible work whenever possible. We trust our people to fulfil their responsibilities, know when in-person collaboration creates the greatest value and are present when it matters most.

**We encourage you to apply

**Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

**All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to the interview.

**How to apply?

**Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 30 November 2026. Applications are assessed continuously, so don’t wait to send yours.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

**Join us in bringing people closer

**GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhances the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, and provide great experiences for audio and gaming users.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

High-Tech Defence | Brand Building | Creative Execution | AI-Driven Marketing

Our Ambition is to not look like just another traditional defence company. We want a brand that reflects the future of defence technology: bold, innovative, technically credible, visually outstanding, and internationally recognized.

UMag Solutions is a fast-growing defence technology company developing advanced Quantum Magnetic Sensing payloads for autonomous systems for land- and naval mine detection and anti-submarine warfare. Our end-customers are typically within defence and governments around the world – both via B2B and B2G sales.

Today, we are a team of approximately 45 highly skilled professionals. Over the next three years, we expect to triple our organization and establish subsidiaries in key international markets. This growth requires a senior, creative, commercially minded, and hands-on Head of Marketing to build a distinctive international brand and strengthen how we communicate our technology, products, capabilities, and partnerships.

Our ambition is to create a modern, innovative, and visually outstanding defence technology brand that combines technical credibility with compelling storytelling and strong commercial impact.

Together with the existing marketing team, you will be responsible for developing our marketing strategy, brand identity, and creative execution across our website, social media, international exhibitions, product brochures, videos, presentations, and other marketing channels.

You will work closely with our Sales, Operations, Support & Logistics, and Technical Solutions & Partnerships teams, transforming their commercial insights, product demonstrations, and technical expertise into high-quality marketing material that supports business growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You know the craft and stay hands-on in the daily work. You bring in the right specialists to help, and you own the result. You are supported by the wider team and the existing marketing team.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Marketing Leadership & Execution

• Together with the CCO and marketing team, develop the company's marketing strategy, priorities, and activity plans.

• Lead and develop the existing junior marketing/business development colleague.

• Manage external designers, agencies, photographers, and other specialists when needed.

• Establish brand guidelines, marketing processes, and a structured content production pipeline.

• Manage the marketing budget and monitor the effectiveness of key activities.

• Remain actively involved in creative production and day-to-day execution.

2. Brand Development & Creative Direction

• Develop and continuously strengthen a distinctive, modern, and premium brand identity.

• Establish a consistent and recognizable visual expression across all marketing channels.

• Position the company as an innovative and credible player in the international defence technology industry.

• Develop creative campaigns, visual concepts, and storytelling that differentiate us from traditional defence companies.

• Ensure high-quality design, messaging, and communication across all external materials.

3. Content Creation & Technical Storytelling

• Translate sophisticated defence technologies into clear, compelling, and commercially relevant communication.

• Produce professional brochures, product sheets, presentations, technical illustrations, and marketing materials.

• Develop high-quality written content for websites, social media, press releases, and corporate communication.

• Create and edit videos, animations, and visual presentations of our products and capabilities.

• Work with technical specialists to ensure that all marketing content is accurate, credible, and appropriate for external release.

4. Website, Digital Marketing & Social Media

• Own and continuously improve the corporate website, including design, content, user experience, and product presentation.

• Develop engaging content for LinkedIn and other relevant digital channels.

• Create graphics, animations, videos, and digital campaigns that communicate our capabilities.

• Support search engine visibility, digital marketing activities, and performance tracking.

• Ensure our digital presence reflects our technology, ambition, and international positioning.

5. Trade Shows, Exhibitions & Events

• Take responsibility for the company's visual identity and marketing presence at international defence exhibitions.

• Develop innovative booth concepts, exhibition graphics, product videos, presentations, and promotional materials.

• Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Technical Solutions & Partnerships to present a coherent and compelling company story.

• Support customer demonstrations, product showcases, and partner activities at exhibitions.

• Ensure that exhibitions strengthen brand recognition and support commercial objectives.

6. Commercial Marketing & Sales Support

• Work closely with the Sales team to understand customer needs, market opportunities, and commercial priorities.

• Develop compelling sales presentations, customer-specific materials, product brochures, and other sales-enablement tools.

• Support sales campaigns, product launches, customer visits, and strategic business development initiatives.

• Ensure that marketing activities support the sales pipeline and international growth objectives.

• Maintain consistency between external marketing messages and the company's commercial positioning.

7. Product Demonstrations & Operations Collaboration

• Collaborate closely with the Operations team, which is responsible for conducting product demonstrations and operational activities.

• Plan and coordinate the marketing aspects of demonstrations, including photography, video recording, visual content, and communication.

• Transform product demonstrations, field activities, and operational capabilities into engaging marketing stories.

• Develop demonstration videos, product showcases, and other materials that highlight the company's technology in real-world applications.

8. Technical Solutions & Strategic Partnerships

• Work closely with the Technical Solutions & Partnerships team as well as Product Managers to understand product capabilities, technical solutions, integrations, and new developments.

• Translate technical input into clear product messaging, illustrations, presentations, and marketing content.

• Develop marketing material highlighting collaborations and integrations with drone manufacturers, defence companies, and other technology partners.

• Support joint marketing initiatives, partner announcements, co-branded materials, and technology showcases.

• Ensure that technical claims, product specifications, and integration descriptions are validated by the relevant technical specialists.

• Help communicate the value of the company's broader technology ecosystem and strategic partnerships.

9. AI-Driven Marketing & Creative Production

• Actively use modern AI tools to accelerate and improve marketing production.

• Apply AI to graphic concepts, content creation, video production, presentations, and marketing workflows.

• Identify and implement tools that improve marketing quality, efficiency, and scalability.

• Combine AI-generated material with professional creative judgment and strong quality control.

• Ensure that all AI usage complies with company confidentiality, security, intellectual property, and information-handling requirements.

Your Profile

We are looking for a senior marketing leader with sound judgment, a sharp eye for quality, exceptional English, and a commercial mindset.

Essential Qualifications

• Exceptional English, written and spoken, at native or near-native level. All our external communication is in English, and you set the standard for it.

• Proven senior experience in marketing, branding, digital communication, or creative marketing leadership.

• Excellent graphic design skills and a strong eye for visual identity, layout, typography, and aesthetics.

• Hands-on experience producing websites, brochures, presentations, digital campaigns, and social media content.

• Experience with video production, editing, and visual storytelling.

• Strong practical proficiency with modern AI tools for marketing and creative production.

• Experience with creative tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, Affinity, or equivalent software.

• Ability to understand complex technical products and communicate their value clearly.

• Strong collaboration skills and experience working across commercial and technical functions.

• Ability to combine strategic thinking with independent, hands-on execution.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in defence, aerospace, drones, robotics, advanced manufacturing, or other high-tech product industries.

• Experience with international B2B and B2G marketing and technical product marketing.

• Familiarity with motion graphics, 3D visualization, and technical animations.

• Experience developing marketing content from product demonstrations and real-world operational activities.

• Experience with partner marketing, technology ecosystems, and joint product announcements.

• Experience with international exhibitions and trade shows.

Personal Characteristics

• Creative: You know how to make sophisticated technology visually exciting.

• Hands-on: You enjoy producing high-quality material yourself.

• Commercially minded: You understand how marketing supports sales and business growth.

• Technically curious: You enjoy working with engineers, technical specialists, and operational teams.

• Collaborative: You can bring together people from different functions and turn their input into compelling communication.

• AI-driven: You actively explore and apply new technologies to improve marketing.

• Structured and proactive: You take ownership and deliver results.

• Ambitious: You want to help build an internationally recognized defence technology brand.

What We Offer

• The chance to help grow one of Denmark's leading defence companies.

• Significant creative freedom and responsibility.

• Close collaboration with Sales, Operations, engineering, and strategic partners.

• A steep but exciting learning curve in advanced technology and international defence.

• Real opportunities to develop, professionally and personally.

• Great colleagues across marketing, sales, engineering, and operations.

• A good working environment with short decision paths.

• An office in a creative environment, surrounded by nature, 20 minutes from central Copenhagen.

Why Join Us?

You will join a fast-moving and highly innovative tech company at a defining moment in its journey—from an innovative scale-up to an internationally recognized defence technology company backed by the Bridgepoint Group.

Apply

Here’s what the job entails

As our Head of Enterprise Data & Insights, you will build, lead and grow Enterprise Business Intelligence and Master Data Management – two teams, one purpose: dependable figures and core data across Danske Commodities.

Working closely with Product Managers, architects, data owners and business colleagues, you will contribute to making our data consistent, reducing manual reconciliation and creating the foundation for scalable operations, analytics and AI.

More concretely, your areas of responsibility will include:

• building, leading and continuously developing the teams with full people responsibility

• fostering psychological safety and high team performance

• growing our master and reference data service, keeping core data matched, validated and consistent across our systems

• delivering trusted company figures to Finance, Risk and Controlling, grounded in definitions and quality standards agreed with the data’s business owners

• leading both teams to develop mature ways of working within our product operating model, applying agile principles to improve flow, and ensuring clear communication and transparent roadmaps so the internal product teams and back-office teams that depend on their services can plan and coordinate effectively

Meet your team

Drive strategy, performance, and operational excellence across the organization

Adept leader with technical abilities and a strong commercial mindset

Set and execute the strategic direction at Form & Frys
